note: Rewritten from the species description in Carrijo, Constantini & Scheffrahn (2016), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown in the original; no separate morphological description is given for the worker, only its measurements are recorded; figure numbers, type material, biological notes and distributional records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier head capsule and frontal tube are densely covered with short setae; U. teevani, the only congener, has a head capsule with only sparse long setae and a bare frontal tube, and the two are separated on this basis. The genus is characterized by strongly outcurved soldier mandibles, margins of the pro-, meso- and metanotum without spines, and fore coxae without processes. Alates not seen.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Monotypic. Head capsule circular in dorsal view. Antenna 15-segmented, relative-length formula 1>2>3=4<5. Nasus narrowly conical in profile, at about 30° to the head base; the dorsal edge of the nasus is not demarcated from the vertex margin and curves together with the occipital margin. Labrum rounded, anterior margin translucent, without a distinct apical point. Postmentum nearly rectangular. Mandibles symmetrical, piercing, hook-shaped; a small subconical tooth on the inner margin near the middle; molar region absent; in dorsal view the two mandibles almost completely overlap when closed. Anterior lobe of the pronotum longer than the posterior lobe. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Head capsule densely covered with short setae and sparsely with long setae; nasus with many short setae, a ring of short setae at the apex. Margins of the pronotum with long and short setae, denser on the lateral margins, the anterior lobe with some short setae. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum with long and short setae; abdominal tergites and sternites completely covered with dense long setae. Legs with many long and short setae, stout setae on the inner surface of the tibiae. Measurements (3 nests, 6 soldiers, mm; range (mean)): head length 1.30—1.40 (1.35), nasus length 1.43—1.58 (1.50), left mandible length 0.93—1.00 (0.96), head width 1.35—1.43 (1.38), pronotum width 0.80—0.88 (0.84), hind tibia length 1.68—1.80 (1.74).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: No separate morphological description is given in the original, which only states that the morphology agrees with the genus characters as recorded by Rocha et al. (2012). Measurements (3 nests, 12 workers, mm; range (mean)): head length 0.75—1.00 (0.94), head width 1.13—1.30 (1.21), hind tibia length 1.33—1.50 (1.43).
